question: Rajpal and Rampal are two brothers. Sunita is the sister-in-law of Rajpal. Ragubir is the father of Sunita. Sunita is the only sister of Vikram. Harsh is the only son of Sunita. How is Rampal related to Harsh?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24da8914664d10453c9d9ab26b8ab431f913e3fc49dcd23b79b6043ac90be683.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6358b58e736c1b8ca24002ccaf27ccdb83db42413652a7f75920f0abc7e1654d.png]

Hence, ‘**Father**’ is the correct answer.
